checks.message: Provisional boundary is explicit and traceable; content review may proceed, while official-geometry-dependent professional scoring remains pending.
Three required key areas are explicit provisional constraints and must be replaced/recalculated when official polygons arrive.
Seven adjacent land-use polygons cover the submitted site without overlap.
Design polygons and scenario points are clipped to the provisional site.
Known spatial metrics are recomputed in EPSG:4548 from submitted geometry.
Chinese and English proposal, report, visual, figure and drawing counterparts are generated and mapped.
Static offline HTML uses only local images and inline CSS.
Sections, standards, depth items, matrices, geometry, metrics, sources and assumptions are linked.
Formal professional scoring that depends on official geometry remains a documented organizer-data gate; this is not a participant defect.
